context:
You asked, 15:09 CDT: what is e2? It was option A's hidden key; the page shows only A, B, C, and the item wrongly named keys. Fixed: this item now uses the letters you see. Your saves at 15:05 and 15:09 both chose A, the setup script; that stands and goes to the coordinator.

The cause: agents/builder.md names no model, so a builder spawned without one reads a setting (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL) that a cloud session writes too late; the builder then runs Opus. Until this is built, the coordinator names Sonnet by hand on each builder spawn.

Recommended: A, your pick. It fixes the cause, the missing install before start. B is a one-line stopgap that can ship today; it reverses the no-pin choice in your record agent-model-cap. C treats the symptom.

options.gain: Fixes the cause: every cloud session starts with your settings, builder model included.
options.how: The environment's setup script fetches claude-settings and runs install.sh before Claude Code starts. You paste the script once per environment; one fresh session then proves a bare builder runs Sonnet.
options.label: Setup script installs claude-settings before start, then one test
options.lose: Your paste, once per environment; a new environment misses it until pasted.

options.gain: Fixed today, everywhere, with no test and nothing for you to paste.
options.how: One line in agents/builder.md. A round-3 spawn still asks for Opus.
options.label: Pin model: sonnet in agents/builder.md (stopgap)
options.lose: Reverses agent-model-cap's no-pin choice: the setting can no longer move builders.

options.gain: Nothing for you to do; your no-pin record stays.
options.how: First one test in a fresh cloud session. If it passes, the guard refuses a bare builder spawn and says to add model sonnet; an override still lifts it.
options.label: Guard refuses a builder spawn that names no model, after one test
options.lose: Treats the symptom, not the late settings; one refused spawn when a session forgets.

ref: decision agent-model-cap (the model each role runs), sentence: "agents/builder.md carries no model: key, so a builder spawn reads the fallback."
title: Builder on Sonnet: A, B or C?
why: It changes how every builder's model is chosen, which your record agent-model-cap set.
